senses.gloss: f.(b. h. חֶלְיָה; חלי, cmp. חָלָל III; cmp. גִּלָּה) [loose part, something movable,] limb, link; vertebra of the spinal column.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:5">Bekh. VI, 5</cite> <he>בין ח׳ לח׳</he> (Talm. ed. 39ᵇ <he>מח׳ לח׳</he>) between two vertebrae.—
<cite ref="Chullin 52a:1">Ḥull. 52ᵃ</cite> if a rib is displaced <he>וח׳ עמה</he> and a vertebra with it.
Y. Succ. I, 51ᵈ ח׳ של עמוד a segment of a column.
Men. 38ᵇ ח׳ a joint of the plaited show-threads.—Pl. חוּלְיוֹת, חֲלָיוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:8">Kel. XI, 8</cite> a chain <he>שח׳ שלה וכ׳</he> the links of which are of metal stringed on &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ של אבנים וכ׳</he> links consisting of jewels, pearls &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:7">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00714"><he>דְּיָקִינְתִּין</he></cite>. Ohol. I, 8 <he>שמונה עשרה ח׳</he> eighteen vertebrae.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 22a:5">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מנורה של חליות</he> a candlestick which can be taken apart.

Kel. V, 8; 10 חתכו ח׳ if he cut the burned clay of an oven into tiles; a. fr.—Esp. a segment of earth cut out in digging a pit and piled up on its borders; (collect.) the entrenchment around a well (increasing its capacity).

<cite ref="Berakhot 3b">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 59a:2">59ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>אין הבור מתמלא מחוּלְיָתוֹ</he> a pit cannot be filled up with its own earth, i.e. a community cannot live on its own resources.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 11:2">Sabb. XI, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 99a:6">99ᵃ</cite>) <he>חוּלְיַת הבור</he> (<cite ref="H00347"><he>חוּלְיַית</he></cite>, Mish. <he>חוּלְיוֹת</he>, pl.) the entrenchment of a well.

<cite ref="Eruvin 78a">Erub. 78ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 99a:6">Sabb. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>בור וחוּלְיָתָהּ</he> (<he>וחוּלְיָי׳</he>) <he>וכ׳</he> the depth of the well and its entrenchment are counted together to make up ten hand-breadths.
<cite ref="Shabbat 99b:8">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>בור תשעה … ח׳</he> if the pit was nine hand-breadths deep, and he took out of the bottom one segment (which had been cut before this).
<cite ref="Shabbat 99b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ונתן לתוכה ח׳</he> and threw a segment in.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 51a:18">B. Kam. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>עקרו שניהם ח׳ וכ׳</he> both of them took the last segment out together, so as to complete the legal depth &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 84b:7">Yoma 84ᵇ</cite> <he>עוקר ח׳</he> break loose one segment of the entrenchment; a. fr.
